olivia: quick ping — saw a user report that the example diagram in docs/guides/timeout-tuning.md 403s in prod. can someone grab this tiny fix? /cc @marc
docs-bot: [alert] asset-check failed: /docs/guides/timeout-tuning#diagram (403) scanned 2026-01-12T10:02:00Z
marc: I can take it. Which file path and image URL?
olivia: File: docs/guides/timeout-tuning.md. Image currently points to https://assets-old.example.com/diags/timeout-flow.svg. Swap to our normalized asset path and add `maintainer: marc` in frontmatter. Also add a one-liner under "Notes": "Diagram rehosted to CDN 2026-01-12"
marc: plan: 1) replace absolute URL with relative `assets/diags/timeout-flow.svg` 2) add frontmatter `maintainer: marc` 3) add changelog entry 4) run `mkdocs build` + `tools/link-checker` locally 5) open PR with label `smallfix`. ETA ~15m
riley: tiny accessibility nit: please include alt text `alt=\"timeout tuning flow\"` and a caption line so the change shows up in search results.
marc: good call. local steps i'll run:
```bash
git checkout -b docs/rehost-timeout-diagram-329
# edit file
mkdocs build && tools/link-checker --site-dir site
```
marc: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9817 — title: "docs: rehost timeout tuning diagram + maintainer" — labels: docs, smallfix
docs-bot: Deploy preview ready — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/9817 — link-checker: passed — image served 200
riley: i'll do a quick review. nit: prefer no leading slash in path and include your handle in OWNERS if you want pings: `guides/: - marc (@marc-gh)`
marc: updated branch with relative path and added OWNERS entry. Added changelog line: "2026-01-12 — guides/timeout-tuning: image rehost + maintainer — marc"
marc: rebuilt locally, preview shows image and caption. marking PR as ready for review.
olivia: thank you! tagging this for merge after riley's LG and CI green. :rocket:
